Create a 10 second finished scene for episode 4 of a Chinese 2D cinematic anime crime drama. Reference 1 shows the ALREADY OPEN wardrobe and pipe recess, reference 2 shows Jian Ci (pale adult male, black hair, black turtleneck, white coat, black gloves) and Lin Qian (adult woman, short black bob, dark navy police uniform); reference 3 shows Qi Yun (adult male maintenance worker, short brown-black hair, charcoal work jacket, grey undershirt), crouching inside the pipe recess with both hands already raised. Match these exact faces, clothes and hand positions. References are identity and location guides, NOT a storyboard to replay. The door is already open and stays open. Single-level third-floor room, NO stairs. No new people. Black touchscreen phone stays on its original brick ledge and can remain out of frame. Qi Yun stays seated/crouched throughout; nobody abruptly stands up. Quiet low-key blue window light and motivated warm bulb, detailed visible faces, tense restrained acting. Exactly TWO shots with a clean motivated cut around 5 seconds, NO montage, NO reset to the reference image, no repeated gestures or head turns. Maintain eyelines and 180 degree axis.
AUDIO IS ESSENTIAL: audible clear fluent Mandarin dialogue, dry and close, natural lip synchronization. Male Jian Ci has a calm low young-adult baritone; female Lin Qian has a clear firm medium-low female voice; male Qi Yun has a tense breathy younger male voice. Different characters must not share voices. Only the named speaker moves their mouth. Other characters listen silently. Speak ONLY the Chinese words quoted below, exactly once, in the assigned timing; no additional narration, no mumbling, no chanting, no reading labels, no music. Quiet room ambience between lines. NO rendered subtitles, captions, logos or any text anywhere. Each utterance must finish before its shot cuts.

dialogue.speaker: 林浅
dialogue.en: Stay still. Tell me your name.

dialogue.speaker: 检刺
dialogue.en: Don't stand up yet. Feeling dizzy?

dialogue.speaker: 检刺
dialogue.en: Lin Qian, call for medical help.

dialogue.speaker: 祁昀
dialogue.zh: 我看见他昨晚封这块板。
